question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
-- Find all consecutive /detail pairs and their following page
WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, path, stamp, option
  FROM activity_log
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT session, path, stamp, option,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) AS rn
  FROM deduped
),
consecutive_detail AS (
  SELECT n1.session, n1.path AS detail1_path, n1.stamp AS detail1_stamp,
    n2.path AS detail2_path, n2.stamp AS detail2_stamp,
    n3.path AS third_path, n3.stamp AS third_stamp, n3.rn
  FROM numbered n1
  JOIN numbered n2 ON n1.session = n2.session AND n2.rn = n1.rn + 1
  LEFT JOIN numbered n3 ON n1.session = n3.session AND n3.rn = n1.rn + 2
  WHERE (n1.path = '/detail' OR n1.path = '/detail/') 
    AND (n2.path = '/detail' OR n2.path = '/detail/')
)
SELECT third_path, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM consecutive_detail
WHERE third_path IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY third_path
ORDER BY cnt DESC, third_path
